concept: Athena: serverless SQL over data in S3 (Parquet)
tests: Choosing a service for ad hoc SQL queries on large Parquet files in S3 without managing servers.
expected: Amazon Athena — serverless SQL directly over S3, pay per data scanned. Triggers: "ad hoc SQL", "Parquet in S3", "without managing servers".
why_not: Redshift — a cluster for a persistent data warehouse; RDS — transactional DB; persistent EMR — operational overhead.
